content: The treasury of jewels of the three secrets of all the Victorious Ones,The casket in which they are gathered,To the Lama Mi-bskyod-rdo-rje,I bow down and set forth the easy practice of meditation and recitation.Regarding the method of meditation and recitation of the glorious Guhyasamāja—which is the principal of all the Unexcelled Yoga Tantra classes, and because its mantras are the condensed essence of all the Buddhas, it is said to draw forth the blessings of all the Victorious Ones simultaneously—first, the taking of refuge and the generation of bodhicitta:Accomplished by the mind’s play, like the stainless moon,The method of infinite, holy compassion,Which abides within one’s own mind—I always go for refuge to the Sugatas.Definitely liberated from all conceptualizations,The basis of excellence for the holy beings,The very essence of the single taste of all things—I always go for refuge to the holy Dharma.Completely liberated from the fetters,Possessing the glory produced by supreme compassion,Dwelling firmly on the stages such as the "Very Joyous"—I go for refuge to the assembly of the masters of ascetic discipline.Through the maturation of intention and action,The habitual tendencies of all obscurations are thoroughly eradicated.Adorned by the supreme resolve of devotion,I shall generate the holy mind of enlightenment.Then, one emerges as Dveshavajra, with a body color of dark blue, and three faces—dark blue, white, and red—and six arms; the right hands hold a vajra, a wheel, and a lotus, and the left hands hold a bell, a jewel, and a sword, being embraced by the consort Sparshavajra who is similar to oneself. Both are adorned with the eight precious ornaments; the upper body is draped with a shawl of celestial fabric, and the lower body hangs with a skirt of celestial silk. Thus, one is generated in an instant. At one’s crown is Vairochana, at the throat Amitabha, at the heart Akshobhya (it is said to be important not to omit this), at the navel Ratnasambhava, and at the base of the thighs Amoghasiddhi. At the navel is Lochana, at the heart Mamaki, at the throat Pandaravasini, at the crown Tara, in the eyes Kshitigarbha, in the ears Vajrapani, in the nose Akashagarbha, on the tongue Avalokiteshvara, at the heart Manjushri, in the secret place Sarvanivaranavishkambhin, in the joints Kshitigarbha, and at the crown Maitreya. At the gate of the eyes is Rupavajra, at the gate of the ears Shabdavajra, at the gate of the nose Gandhavajra, at the gate of the mouth Rasavajra, and at the gate of the vajra Sparshavajra. In the right hand is Yamantaka, in the left hand Achala, at the mouth Hayagriva, at the vajra Amritakundali, at the base of the right shoulder Mi.g.yo.ba, at the base of the left shoulder Kamaraja, at the right knee Niladanda, at the left knee Mahabala, at the crown Ushnishachakravartin, and at the two soles of the feet Mahakrodha. Thus, the body mandala is arranged.From the HŪṂ at my heart, light rays radiate, inviting the Victorious Ones from Akaniṣṭha. JAḤ HŪṂ VAṂ HOḤ. They become indivisible from one's own samaya-being. Contemplating that the wisdom-being is established as one's own nature, I imagine that the wisdom-being of each deity—the one-faced, two-armed Father and Mother—bestows empowerment upon each deity with a stream of nectar of bodhicitta.OṂ SARVA TATHĀGATA AGGHAṂ PRATĪCCHA HŪṂ SVĀHĀ. Likewise, (offer by applying) PĀDYAṂ, PUṢPA, DHŪPE, ĀLOKE, GANDHE, NAIVIDYA, and ŚABDA.Akṣobhyavajra, great primordial wisdom,The Vajra Realm, the great expanse,The three supreme vajras, the three maṇḍalas,To the secret melody, I prostrate.Vairocana, the great purity,Vajra peace, the great joy,The supreme of the supreme, naturally luminous,To the Teacher, the Vajra-holder, I prostrate.The Jewel King, profoundly deep,The stainless vajra, like the sky,Naturally pure, unstained,To the Vajra Body, I prostrate.Great King of the Immeasurable Vajra,Holder of the non-conceptual vajra-expanse,You who have attained the perfection of passion,To the Vajra Speech, I prostrate.Amoghavajra, the perfect Buddha,You who fulfill all aspirations,Arisen from the essence of purity,To Vajrasattva, I prostrate.(Thus having praised, contemplate the seed syllables at the hearts of the deities of the body maṇḍala, surrounded by their respective mantras, and focus upon the letters and mantra garlands at their three centers.)OṂ ĀḤ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ VAJRADHṚKA HŪṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ SPARŚAVAJRA KHAṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ JINAJIK OṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ RATNADHṚK SVĀHŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ ĀROLIK ĀḤ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ PRAJÑĀDHṚK HĀ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ MOHARATI LAṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ DVEṢARATI MAṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ RĀGARATI BAṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ VAJRARATI TĀṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ RŪPAVAJRA JA HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ ŚABDAVAJRA HŪṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ GANDHEVAJRA BAṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ RASAVAJRA HOḤ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ MAITRI MAIṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ KṢITIGARBHE THILĀṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ VAJRAPĀṆI OṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ VAṂGARBHE OṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ LOKEŚVARA OṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ MAÑJUŚRĪ HŪṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ SARVANĪVARAṆAVISKHAMBHINI OṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ SAMANTABHADRA SAṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ YAMĀNTAKṚT HŪṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ PRAJÑĀNTAKṚT HŪṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ MADHŪNTAKṚT HŪṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ VIGHNĀNTAKṚT HŪṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ ACALA HŪṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ ṬAKKIRĀJA HŪṂ HŪṂ, OṂ ĀḤ.(Thus, recite the mantras of the principal deity and the retinue. Recite the hundred-syllable mantra. Contemplate that from the point of union of yourself as father and mother in consort, light rays of bodhicitta radiate, empowering all sentient beings, purifying their obscurations, and transforming them into the syllable HŪṂ. From the transformation of these, which completely fill the expanse of space, those who have become Vajradharas are drawn back by one's own light rays and dissolve into oneself. Meditate on the purification and transformation of the environment and its inhabitants by reciting: Oṃ yoga śuddha sarva dharma yoga śuddho 'ham.)By this merit, may I quicklyAttain the state of the sovereign Lord Vajradhara,The very essence of all the Buddhas,And may all wandering beings also attain it.May I practice the two modes of conductPraised by the Vajra of Awakening:The conduct for the sake of perfect awakening,And the conduct practiced after becoming a perfect Buddha.May this ultimate, wondrous pathBe accomplished properly without obstacles,And having flourished and spread throughout all times and directions,May it liberate all beings through these skillful means.(Thus, make intense prayers. At bedtime, visualize the deities of one’s own body—Vairocana, Locanā, Kṣitigarbha, Rūpavajrā, Maitreya, Yamāntaka, and Acala—dissolving in sequence into the clear light. Then, Ratnasambhava, Māmakī, Vajrapāṇi, Gītavajrā, Aparājita, and Rāgarāja dissolve in sequence into the clear light. Then, Amitābha, Pāṇḍaravāsinī, Ākāśagarbha, Gandhavajrā, Hayagrīva, and Nīladaṇḍa dissolve in sequence into the clear light. Then, Amoghasiddhi, Tārā, Avalokiteśvara, Rasavajrā, Sarvanīvaraṇaviṣkambhin, Sparśavajrā, Samantabhadra, Vighnāntaka, and Mahābala dissolve in sequence into the clear light. Then, Uṣṇīṣacakravartin, Ucchuṣma, and Mañjuśrī dissolve in sequence into the clear light, and the principal deity also dissolves into the clear light. Perform this dissolution sequence. At dawn, imagine being awakened by the songs of the four goddesses, such as Locanā, and arising from the clear light into the divine form. One should strive to make this human life meaningful through such uninterrupted daily practice.)It is said:Through the Secret Mantra, which is rarer even than the Buddhas,At this juncture of having encountered the Dharma by good fortune,If I am able to create the habitual tendenciesTo attain buddhahood in a single lifetime, I am satisfied.(This daily practice of the meditation and recitation of the glorious Guhyasamāja was set down as a liturgy by the one named Hayaghoṣa, following the oral instructions of the guru, with the hope that it may also benefit others who share the same fortune. The scribe was the student Dpal-ldan-'od-zer. May virtue and excellence increase.)
